'''Shavree''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who sold a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] shopkeeper aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. She claimed the lightsaber was hers, but did not display an [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] to back up her claim.

==Behind the scenes==
Shavree was only mentioned in the reprinted ''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]'' adventure that was included in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Two]]''. She was not mentioned in the original printing of the adventure.
